calls.video_title: Why Is Cerebras Stock Falling and is it a Buy Right Now?
calls.thesis: BUY reiterated - ranked a buying opportunity 17 Nov, reiterated today (first tracked CBRS call). Stock down 72% in 2026 on OpenAI capacity-delivery delays (behind schedule until H2 2027), but revenue expected to triple in 2027, long-term gross margin >60% and operating margin >40%; $7.8bn cash vs $1.35bn long-term debt; forward P/E 53 and forward P/S 8, near 2026 lows. DCF fair value figure was not captured in the captions - only that it leaves significant upside from $99. High risk (beta 3), only for high-risk-tolerance investors.
calls.base_case: OpenAI deliveries get back on schedule in H2 2027; revenue triples in 2027 and margins expand toward the 60%/40% long-term targets.
calls.bull_case: Hyperscaler wins (AWS, Oracle, Microsoft) scale cloud revenue; valuation re-rates as free cash flow turns positive in 2028.
calls.bear_case: Delays run past H2 2027 (90-day delay clause lets either party cancel part of the OpenAI take-or-pay deal); operating margin stays near -99% and free cash flow stays negative beyond 2027.
